subject: english
stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Jenny wrote in her report that the market was not just a place to buy food.”?
options: A familiar object can make a new place feel ready for work.
Sometimes improving the place where work happens helps the person doing the work.
Changing the time can change the feeling of a place.
It was a place where time, work, and relationships met before breakfast.
